questions.question: Which living mammal has the highest number of teeth?
questions.hint: Spinner dolphins can have 240–260 teeth, among the highest counts of any living mammal.

questions.question: Which tree species is considered the largest living organism by volume?
questions.hint: While Coast Redwoods are taller, Giant Sequoias possess the greatest volume of any tree on Earth.

questions.question: Which film became the first to win 11 Academy Awards?
questions.hint: Released in 1959, Ben-Hur was the first film to win 11 Oscars, a record later tied by Titanic and The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King.

questions.question: Which fictional city is protected by Batman?
questions.hint: Batman has defended Gotham City since his first appearance in 1939.

questions.question: Which international organization awards the Nobel Peace Prize?
questions.hint: Unlike the other Nobel Prizes, the Peace Prize is selected by the Norwegian Nobel Committee.

questions.question: Which organization is responsible for assigning internet domain names and IP address coordination?
questions.hint: ICANN coordinates domain names, IP address allocation, and parts of the global Domain Name System.

questions.question: Which civilization constructed the monumental statues known as the Moai?
questions.hint: The Moai statues were carved by the Rapa Nui people on Easter Island between the 13th and 16th centuries.

questions.question: Which ancient library became the most famous center of learning in antiquity?
questions.hint: The Library of Alexandria symbolized the pursuit of knowledge in the ancient world.

questions.question: Which country has won the most Olympic gold medals in hockey (field hockey, men's)?
questions.hint: India dominated Olympic men's field hockey during the early and mid-20th century with 8 gold medals.

questions.question: In Formula One, what color flag signals the end of a race or practice session?
questions.hint: The black-and-white checkered flag marks the official finish of the session.

questions.question: Which country contains the highest capital city in the world?
questions.hint: La Paz, Bolivia, is the world's highest administrative capital at about 3,650 meters (11,975 feet) above sea level.

questions.question: Which strait separates Asia from North America?
questions.hint: The Bering Strait lies between Russia and Alaska, separating Asia and North America.

questions.question: Which scientist developed the first successful vaccine?
questions.hint: Jenner's smallpox vaccine, introduced in 1796, marked the beginning of modern immunology.

questions.question: Which subatomic particle was discovered by J. J. Thomson in 1897?
questions.hint: The discovery of the electron revolutionized the understanding of atomic structure.

questions.question: Which civilization built the massive stone city of Great Zimbabwe?
questions.hint: Great Zimbabwe was the capital of a powerful medieval African kingdom between the 11th and 15th centuries.

questions.question: Which language is written using the Hangul writing system?
questions.hint: Hangul was created in the 15th century during the reign of King Sejong.

questions.question: Which living bird has the largest wingspan?
questions.hint: The Wandering Albatross has the largest wingspan of any living bird, reaching over 3.5 meters (11.5 feet).

questions.question: Which country shares the most international borders with other nations?
questions.hint: China shares land borders with 14 countries, tied with Russia for the most. To avoid ambiguity, both China and Russia share the record.

questions.question: Which law states that energy cannot be created or destroyed, only transformed?
questions.hint: The First Law of Thermodynamics expresses the principle of conservation of energy.

questions.question: Which empire constructed the famous Machu Picchu mountain citadel?
questions.hint: Built in the 15th century, Machu Picchu is regarded as one of the greatest achievements of Inca engineering and architecture.
